jobs_results.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Description

The Automation Engineer I supports the implementation, integration, and continuous improvement of automation solutions for manufacturing operations, including CNC machining, robotics, inspection, material handling, and packaging. Under the guidance of senior engineers or project leads, the role supports equipment integration, testing, validation, startup, production handoff, and sustaining support. The position works with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Tooling, and external suppliers to deliver safe, reliable, and maintainable automation that meets project and production requirements. The role provides hands-on development experience with CNC automation, robotics, PLC and HMI systems, vision systems, equipment integration, and validation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES



Assists with automation projects and equipment improvements involving CNC equipment, robots, controls, and vision systems.Works with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Tooling, and external suppliers to complete assigned project activities on schedule and within budget.Reviews project requirements, equipment specifications, drawings, standards, and acceptance criteria with guidance from senior engineers.Applies safety, ergonomics, reliability, maintainability, and design-for-manufacturability principles to assigned equipment and process improvements.Supports coordination with internal resources, equipment suppliers, and integrators during equipment build, installation, testing, and startup.Creates and maintains assigned project documentation, equipment drawings, bills of material, test records, and work instructions.Assists with integrating CNC equipment, robots, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, safety systems, and vision systems into manufacturing processes.Assists with equipment setup, controls integration, and troubleshooting during equipment build, installation, and startup.Develops or updates equipment layouts, component drawings, and equipment modifications using CREO.Assists with robotic applications, including end-of-arm tooling, robot programming, payload setup, I/O handshaking, safety functions, and recovery procedures.Assists with developing, modifying, testing, and troubleshooting PLC, HMI, robot, CNC, and vision-system programs under the guidance of experienced engineers. Supports equipment debug, risk assessments, acceptance testing, validation, startup, operator training, and production handoff.Provides technical support for production equipment, participates in structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and supports approved improvements to safety, quality, uptime, cycle time, and operator efficiency.May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS and KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering technology, or a related technical field.Typically, 0-2 years of relevant experience; internships, co-op assignments, technical projects, and related manufacturing experience may be considered.An equivalent combination of education, technical training, certifications, and relevant experience may be considered.Foundational knowledge of automated equipment, controls, programming, or manufacturing systems gained through education, internships, co-op assignments, technical projects, or relevant work experience.Preferred exposure to one or more of the following: PLCs, HMIs, industrial robots, CNC equipment, vision systems, industrial networks, or CAD tools.Ability to plan assigned work, communicate status and technical issues clearly, maintain accurate documentation, and work effectively in a cross-functional manufacturing environment.

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

   A UiPath developer certification (e.g., UiPath Certified Professional Automation Developer) is preferred, or the ability to obtain it within six (6) months of hire.


  
   Must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to travel.


 
 


 

    Experience:


 
  
   Six (6) or more years of professional automation or software engineering experience, with a record of shipping production automations that take action in real business systems.


  
   Three (3) or more years of hands-on production experience with UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, Robots, queues, and transactional frameworks (e.g., REFramework), with a record of automations running reliably in production.

Automation Engineer





Position Summary:

Catalent’s Baltimore and Harmans, Maryland sites provide industry-leading GMP development and manufacturing services for advanced biopharmaceuticals, including viral vectors, next-generation vaccines, and oncolytic viruses. Our FDA-licensed, state-of-the-art Gene Therapy manufacturing campus in Harmans/BWI features two facilities located just five miles from BWI Airport and 13 miles from downtown Baltimore. The 200,000 sq. ft. Harmans/BWI-1 facility includes 10 GMP suites, fill/finish operations, testing labs, and warehousing, while the 145,000 sq. ft. Harmans/BWI-2 site under development will add 8 GMP suites and expanded cold storage. Together, the campus offers a dynamic environment at the center of Maryland’s biotechnology and research corridor.



The Engineer, Automation will provide key support for various manufacturing systems. This will include Programmable Logic controllers (PLC), OSI-PI for Data Historian, IGNITION for data reporting & remote alarms, process equipment such as Single-Use (SU) Bioreactors, SU Chromatography, Purification & Filtration systems, and Other Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) systems in Manufacturing suites and QC labs. Under the direction of the senior engineers, this role will be responsible for trouble-shooting challenging equipment / automation issues to improve manufacturing performance (e.g. yield improvements, etc.) and maintaining the automation systems in compliance with cGMPs.

jobs_results.description:
This role is being recruited by CoffeeSpace on behalf of an anonymous early-stage startup backed by top-tier investors, building modular automated machine shops to rebuild the US industrial manufacturing base.




We’re identifying a small number of exceptional automation engineers from our network. If there’s a strong fit, we’ll introduce you directly to the founding team.




Location: Austin, Texas, United States




Compensation: $150K–$200K base + meaningful equity




Employment type: Full-time




About the company




This company is focused on rebuilding the US industrial manufacturing base through the development of modular automated machine shops. They are targeting a $50B market with a significant number of unfilled manufacturing jobs projected by 2030. The team is small, currently around three people, and is backed by $9M in funding. Their operations are critical to defense manufacturing, producing parts for rockets, jets, drones, submarines, and munitions.




About the role




As the first Automation Engineer, you will play a foundational role in designing the company's autonomous machining cell strategy. This is a hands-on position requiring daily presence on the shop floor to work directly with CNC machines, robotic cells, and manufacturing equipment.




What You’ll Do

Define standardized tool sets and tool wear parameters to optimize tooling and part coverage.Design a standard vise and workholding system to maximize part range and minimize unique fixtures.Develop and manage the pallet strategy to ensure continuous operation through nights and weekends.Implement machine monitoring hardware to detect issues before they lead to scrapped parts.Lead the selection of machines and equipment for future cell iterations, from requirements to testing.Collaborate with software engineers to integrate automation workflows into manufacturing processes.


Why This Role Is Compelling

You’ll architect an autonomous machining cell from scratch, defining tooling strategies and quality inspection pipelines.Your work directly impacts national security by strengthening US supply chains.As the first automation engineer, you’ll have massive ownership and autonomy.Your systems will be replicated across multiple facilities, offering rare leverage for an individual contributor.Work cross-functionally with software and robotics engineers, integrating systems at the intersection of machining, robotics, and software.


The Ideal Candidate

3+ years of experience in CNC machining and manufacturing engineering.Deep hands-on experience with 5-axis milling and a strong engineering foundation.Comfortable working on the shop floor and thinking at a systems level about tooling and process optimization.Experience with pallet systems, machining hard alloys, or aerospace and defense manufacturing is a plus.


Next steps

1. Apply via this LinkedIn job post2. We’ll review and reach out if there’s a strong match3. If aligned, we’ll introduce you directly to the team4. If this role isn’t the right fit, we may suggest and make introductions to other high-signal startup roles we’re recruiting for, always with your permission.


A quick note on authenticity




This is a real, active role that CoffeeSpace is recruiting for in close partnership with the hiring team. We don’t post speculative roles and work directly with teams on their actual hiring needs.
